question: Does the smallest clean issue #421 research harness exactly reproduce pristine current-main path, RNG, policy and results at null while its observation-only trace exposes the same frozen path?

design.type: four-arm fractional identity design with common random numbers; not a gameplay-factor factorial
design.omittedCells: No pristine capture arm exists because pristine main exposes no trace. No explicit-null capture-off arm is needed: pristine versus capture-off isolates executable substrate, capture-off versus capture-on omitted-null isolates capture, and the two capture-on arms isolate null encoding on the fully observed path. Completing a Cartesian product has no measured decision value.
design.sharedAnchors: All arms use the exact same current-main content, resolved root-551 policy identities, four simulation seed identities, Duskblade Vow-5 setting, baseline semantics, first-look rectangle, estimator and stopping rule.
mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions: executable substrate x trace capture, tested by pristine versus instrumented capture-off followed by instrumented capture-off versus capture-on
trace capture x null encoding, tested by the two capture-on arms so node, play and reward paths are directly comparable
design.aliasStructure: The pristine arm aliases trace and null as unavailable. The capture-off arm identifies instrumented executable identity without observing trajectory. The two capture-on arms separate omitted from explicit null. No gameplay mediator, payoff, candidate or policy factor is varied or estimated.

executableSubstrate.definition: Exact source commit and content in both levels. The instrumented level changes only BalanceSim's trailing research-null and trace parameters plus observation writes.

traceCapture.definition: Off emits no trajectory field. On emits ordered nodes, plays, combat card rewards and boss-relic offers/choices into a caller-owned dictionary without reading it for gameplay.

nullEncoding.definition: Omitted and explicit null have no gameplay hook. Any other key, value or type must terminate before RunState construction.

scorelinePayoff.definition: Separate fixed factor. Current-main Faultline has no research Scoreline payoff; this preflight does not introduce one.

afterimagePayoff.definition: Separate fixed factor. Current-main Warden's Edge has no research Afterimage payoff; this preflight does not introduce one.

acquisitionPriority.definition: Exact sampled policy reward scoring; no research acquisition hook exists.

faultlineRarity.definition: Exact current-main Faultline definition and rarity.

wardSetupPriority.definition: Exact current-main combat policy; no research Ward setup hook exists.

factorDisposition.candidate: None is frozen, constructed, simulated or promoted.
factorDisposition.payoffs: Scoreline and Afterimage remain separate and absent at current-main research-payoff levels.
factorDisposition.ponytailKnobs: No non-null Ward-setup or acquisition knob is implemented. Any future factorial must separately freeze its exact levels and prove full-cohort null identity plus focused mediator isolation against this harness before a causal row.
factorDisposition.additionalMethod: No ML, RL, optimiser or fitted model is used or authorised.

cohort.identity: Policy.sample_range root 551 at the exact policy index and the same simulation seed are reused in all four arms. No identity is selected, removed, replaced or added after execution.

traceDefinition.scope: Observation only. No endpoint, mediator activation, package, payoff, acquisition effect or product claim is estimated from these fields.

estimands.pristineIdentity: Exact canonical row equality for pristine versus instrumented capture-off across all 256 identities.
estimands.captureIdentity: Exact canonical equality after removing only trajectory from capture-on omitted-null, compared with capture-off, across all 256 identities.
estimands.nullPathIdentity: Exact canonical equality including the complete registered trajectory for capture-on omitted-null versus capture-on explicit-null across all 256 identities.
estimands.rngIdentity: Exact equality of the final RNG cursor across all four arms for every identity.
estimands.policyIdentity: Exact equality of the resolved policy snapshot across all four arms for every identity.
estimands.reliability: Any baseline error/stall identity must be retained exactly in every arm; a non-zero shared baseline count is not repaired or selected away.
estimands.traceSchema: Every captured trajectory has exactly the frozen containers and field sets; every play UID is non-negative and every row has at least one node.
estimands.notEstimated: No strategy-package activation, complementarity, payoff, acquisition, rarity, Ward priority, detector, RandomBuild, duration, win-rate, product balance or optimisation endpoint is estimated.

executionAndStopping.construction: Deterministic Python constructs the full row rectangles, content-addresses both plans and outputs, runs the invalid configuration before any RunState, executes pristine once and the fixed three-arm instrumented plan once, performs exact comparisons and owns the stop/go decision.
order: Reject an unregistered research421 key before RunState construction.
Execute the complete fixed 768-row instrumented rectangle.
Analyse all exact contrasts once; no result can add, remove or reprioritise a row.
executionAndStopping.firstLook: The complete 1,024-row design is the only look. No cohort, reserve, repair or rerun exists.
executionAndStopping.stagedConstraint: Capture-off and capture-on use the same frozen cohort. Trace evidence supports path identity only; endpoints are comparably evaluated in every arm before any result claim.

decisionRules.success: The invalid configuration fails closed; every one of the three 256-row exact contrasts has zero mismatches; final RNG and policy snapshots are exact across all four arms; the trace schema has zero faults; all immutable-input and ledger checks pass within 180 seconds.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply decision boundary 1 and freeze exactly this clean current-main null harness and observation schema as the identity anchor for one subsequent zero-row method/mechanism decision. This does not freeze a candidate or authorise a causal simulator row. A later factor must add its own exact definitions, levels, mediator-isolation proof and full-cohort null comparison before execution.
decisionRules.futility: The invalid configuration is accepted, any exact identity or trace-schema check fails, or the ledger changes.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply decision boundary 2: close this null-harness implementation without repair or rerun and continue inside issue #421 from the next evidence-backed structural/methodological boundary. Do not use any failed row for causal, capacity, package, payoff or product claims.
decisionRules.inconclusive: A frozen input is unavailable, either fixed process cannot produce its complete output, or execution exceeds 180 seconds before the exact decision is available.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply decision boundary 3 and record the preflight inconclusive at the cap. Do not add a row, switch cohort, repair, rerun, infer a factor or use protected seeds.
